name: Antigüedad (Spain)
description: Quartered white and light blue above and green and white below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Antigüedad (a sheaf and a hive on green and a tree and building on white).
history: Municipal flag of Antigüedad; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Antigüedad arms — sheaf and hive on green, tree and building on white
cap of the crown of the arms
